name: HERE Obsidian Surface v2
role: Primary structural surface material for the existing HERE app reskin

reskinRules.do: Apply to existing dark surfaces while preserving layout and content hierarchy.
reskinRules.doNot: Do not wrap every section in new geometry. Do not replace media-first areas with marble blocks.
reskinRules.motion: Move light/camera response across normal, roughness and scrollLightMask. Keep stone itself physically stable.
reskinRules.ruby: Ruby may appear only through rubyVeinMask when context already supports a red accent or active transition.
